name: Central mudminnow
description: Small omnivorous fishes: the golden shiner (Notemigonus crysoleucus) and the central mudminnow (Umbra limi). Functional group pooling the source's two minnow taxa, both recorded eating zooplankton and small benthic invertebrates; the source web records no predators for them (their real predators - birds and larger fish - are outside its scope).
notes: Little Rock Lake's minnow node explicitly pools 'shiner & mudminnow'; Tuesday Lake resolves the central mudminnow as its own species node — overlapping resolution, not identical taxa.
